textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · Parts of speech (additional, not in the textbook) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Nouns name people, places, things and ideas: girl, Chennai, bag and kindness. Proper nouns begin with a capital letter, and collective nouns name groups such as a team or a flock.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Nouns name people, places, things and ideas: girl, Chennai, bag and kindness. Proper nouns begin with a capital letter, and collective nouns name groups such as a team or a flock.
beats.speakEn: Nouns name people, places, things and ideas: girl, Chennai, bag and kindness. Proper nouns begin with a capital letter, and collective nouns name groups such as a team or a flock.

beats.en: A pronoun replaces a noun: she, they, it. A possessive pronoun shows ownership: mine, yours, hers and theirs. A reflexive pronoun ends in self or selves: herself.
beats.speakEn: A pronoun replaces a noun: she, they, it. A possessive pronoun shows ownership: mine, yours, hers and theirs. A reflexive pronoun ends in self or selves: herself.
